item.title: Sub-Agents vs Agent Teams: The Architecture Decision That Can Wreck Your System
item.description: The real question is how to choose between Sub-Agents and Agent Teams. Most people immediately think of multi-agent systems when tasks get complex, but that's often the wrong starting point. Understanding the answer can save you countless hours of rework.
